tagline.en_US: Oscam is an Open Source Conditional Access Module software used for descrambling DVB transmissions using smart cards. It's both a server and a client.

description.en_US: Oscam is an Open Source Conditional Access Module software used for descrambling DVB transmissions. It functions as both a server and a client to interface with smart card readers. It allows users to decode broadcast streams and manage conditional access across various media clients.
